doc.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Album Jake Takes Manhattan
summary: Hanna's own album, unrehearsed, with Carmen Leggio, Danny Stiles, Mike Moore and John Bunch.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: You had a couple of albums under your own name off and on?

Yeah I did. One was a mistake. That was called “Jake Takes Manhattan” and it was supposed to be with Rosemary Clooney, although she didn’t show she got sick. And so we just put it together as an album. It was all off the top of my head. We never rehearsed a note. But we did it as we went along. Carmen Leggio, a very, very fine player on that. Danny Stiles. Guys you never heard. But it was the first and sometimes the only record date with that company. And Mike Moore, and John Bunch. So we just threw it together. It came out great.
Yeah he is. I’d sure like to see him in action. See him at these parties or something. Boy he’s great. Great, great player this guy. Funny guy. Very funny guy.
